# Scale by a rounded power of two

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The exact scalar signature is x:F64,n:F64 -&gt; result:F64. With x=8, floating n rounds to the nearest even integer before scaling. The exponent's type remains F64; no implicit promotion or integer shift is claimed.

## What this example demonstrates

The exact scalar signature is x:F64,n:F64 -&gt; result:F64. With x=8, floating n rounds to the nearest even integer before scaling. The exponent's type remains F64; no implicit promotion or integer shift is claimed.
